title: Design and authorize the minimum viable clean-generation foundation
purpose: Freeze the minimum successor-generation product contract, storage isolation boundary, exact 32-file implementation budget, vertical-slice behavior, deterministic build discipline and disjoint multi-AI execution model. This gate enables separately approved subordinate work packages to implement the successor without copying RC718 wholesale and without any RC718 compatibility or learner-state migration layer.
invariants: RC718 source, promoted artifact, browser storage and historical evidence remain unchanged and independently usable.
The successor is rooted at apps/learnit-next and is not an in-place refactor of apps/player.
The frozen contract identifier is learnit.kit.v2 and legacy learnit.import.v1.1 packages fail closed.
Canonical lineage and revision identifiers are opaque lowercase UUIDs persisted by authoring, never derived from titles, slugs, ordering, filenames or local collision suffixes.
The successor uses only localStorage key prefix learnit.next.v1. and IndexedDB database learnit_next_v1.
The successor never reads, writes, clears or deletes RC718 localStorage keys or IndexedDB databases.
The first product slice contains import, library, one course session, QCM and fill activities, progress persistence and refresh recovery only.
The first implementation is limited to the exact 32 working files in FILE_PLAN_V1.json.
The contract is frozen before parallel implementation and may change only through a new architecture work package.
Parallel AI write scopes are disjoint; integration files are owned only by the integrator.
Backend, accounts, synchronization, remote catalog, commerce, tenancy and marketplace remain held.
requiredEvidence: Repository entry points are aligned with RC718 legacy status and the clean-break decision.
The v2 JSON Schema is syntactically valid and contains only the bounded foundation activity families.
The exact 32-file plan assigns one owner to every future file and contains no overlap between implementation roles.
The storage namespace table lists all protected RC718 keys and the distinct successor namespaces.
The vertical-slice acceptance matrix covers empty state, new package import, legacy rejection, session, progress, reload and RC718 storage immutability.
Repository governance, PR scope and Player CI pass on the exact design commit.
adversarialTests: Reject any proposed successor file outside the exact file plan unless a new governor decision changes the budget.

Reject any use of learnit_clean_state_v2, learnit_imported_courses_v1, learnit_import_history_v1, learnit_import_last_applied_v1, learnit_import_transaction_v1, learnit_active_course_v1, learnit_content_patches_v2, learnit_library_revision_v1, learnit_library_persistence_meta_v1 or learnit_durable_library_v1 by successor code.
Reject a legacy package before any durable or transient library mutation.
Reject duplicate lineage or revision identifiers inside one package.
Reject one immutable revision identifier presented with a different canonical digest.
Verify that title and display-label changes do not change canonical identifiers.
Verify that QCM answers use choice identifiers rather than array positions.
Verify that fill answers use explicit slot and token identifiers and enforce token maxUses.
Verify deterministic clean builds and exact tested-artifact identity.
Verify that no held platform domain or RC718 migration logic appears in subordinate work.
nonGoals: Reimplementing the complete RC718 interface or all activity families.
Migrating RC718 libraries, plan labels, sessions, progress, bilans, retention, import history, evidence or patches.
Reading RC718 packages through a compatibility adapter.
Publishing a production-ready authoring skill or complete learning catalog.
Implementing media, matching, ordering, classification, advanced bilan, spaced retention or content patching in the first slice.
Implementing backend, accounts, synchronization, remote catalog, commerce, tenancy or marketplace.
Promoting a successor release without a later human gate.
independentReview: Architecture review challenges contract minimality, identity semantics, dependency direction and source-file budget.
Contradictory QA reviews storage isolation, atomic legacy rejection, digest collision handling and failure recovery.
Learning review confirms that the two foundation activity families and golden-kit scope are sufficient to test a real learning loop without claiming pedagogical completeness.
Integrator review confirms disjoint paths, deterministic build ownership and one source of truth for the contract and manifest.
Governor verifies evidence, claims, assumptions, absence of evidence, active risks and held domains before merge.

executionAuthorization.parallelStartCondition: the contract and file plan are merged, each subordinate work package has the same exact base commit, and all role write scopes are disjoint
executionAuthorization.integrationMode: one integrator after or between reviewed role outputs; no direct merge to main

rollback: Revert this design package before subordinate implementation starts. After subordinate work begins, stop all successor branches and continue using frozen RC718; no RC718 data or artifact is changed by this gate.

nextGate.purpose: Authorize exact subordinate implementation work packages from the ARC-WP-022 merge commit and launch the contract-fixture, runtime, authoring and contradictory-QA streams with disjoint paths.
